cells.gaps: The registry of over 950,000 refugees is registered with a number, but no source says identity documents were issued to them; smart cards are planned from June 2026. One displaced woman paid through a banking app in 2024 does not carry the country. No source since October 2023 counts refugees or displaced people with a SIM, an account or a digital ID.
cells.note: Stage 2: the Commission for Refugees holds a registry of over 950,000 refugees and plans smart cards from June 2026. No source says documents were issued with a number, so question 2 is unmet.
